name: Anzu
source:
The [url=/c98200]transfer student[/url]'s step-sister. She used to attend Kimisaki Academy, but suddenly transferred to Yumenosaki Academy. She is childhood friends with [url=/c98201]Natsumi[/url] and is best friends with [url=/c98206]Suzu[/url].

At Yumenosaki Academy, she acts as an idol producer.
